title: NullPointerException if default ProxySelector is null
body:
Here the test:

```java
private final MockWebServer server = new MockWebServer();
@Before public void setUp() throws Exception { server.start(); }
@After public void tearDown() throws Exception { server.shutdown(); }
@Test public void nullDefaultProxySelector() throws Exception {
  server.enqueue(new MockResponse().setBody("abc"));

  ProxySelector.setDefault(null);

  OkHttpClient client = defaultClient().newBuilder()
      .build();

  Request request = new Request.Builder().url(server.url("/")).build();
  Response response = client.newCall(request).execute();
  assertEquals("abc", response.body().string());
}
```

To quote https://docs.oracle.com/javase/8/docs/api/java/net/ProxySelector.html#setDefault-java.net.ProxySelector-: `ps - The HTTP proxy selector, or null to unset the proxy selector.`, so `null` is an acceptable value that OkHttp should be able to cope with.
